q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of poha (rice flakes) per kg?
title: Poha carbon footprint per kg
short: Start with the paddy per kg of poha and its farm figure, then add soaking, roasting and flaking energy. Divide the mill's fuel and electricity by kg of poha packed and add the pouch or bag.

ul: Paddy by weight per kg of poha.
Husk and bran sold as by-products.
Roasting, often with a husk or wood fired furnace.

p: Report per kg of poha. Paddy farming usually carries more of the footprint than the mill, mainly from field methane.

example.title: Worked example: poha unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 15,540 / 200,000 = 0.0777 kg CO2 per kg
Add paddy for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
